title: Human-Inspired Intuition: Posture and Intermediate Goals

sources.supported_claim: Starting arm posture changes obstacle-avoidance reaching trajectories.
sources.limit: Does not establish a shoulder-first then hand-reaching execution rule.

sources.supported_claim: Human gaze and arm/hand measurements support interpreting obstacle avoidance through an intermediary target; the robot controller uses a via-point before the final goal.
sources.limit: Does not directly validate sequential IK-derived link targets or a shoulder-first execution order.

our_design: Use IK-derived intermediate link targets to guide reaching.
